title: Brown University President Christina Paxson to step down
desc: Brown University President Christina Paxson announced she will step down at the end of the 2026-2027 academic year.

title: Court rejects Brown Mogotsi's bid for witness names
desc: The Johannesburg Magistrates' Court has blocked controversial businessman Brown Mogotsi from getting the names of state witnesses.

title: First deaths reported in cyclosporiasis outbreak
desc: Two people in have died in connection with the outbreak of cyclosporiasis, health officials reported Monday.

title: Israel wins gold, bronze at Under-21 Jiu-Jitsu World Championships in Abu Dhabi
desc: Noga Reshef won gold, and Yoav Solomon claimed bronze as Israel opened the Under-21 Jiu-Jitsu World Championships in Abu Dhabi with two medals and a series of strong performances.

title: Ant teams beat gravity-based puzzle solvers
desc: Ants live in highly organized colonies and cooperate daily to tackle a wide range of problems. Their striking group behaviors have fascinated biologists for centuries and even inspired the development of various artificial intelligence (AI) systems.

title: Simulations hint at a hidden population of companionless black holes
desc: So far, almost all stellar-mass black holes detected by astronomers have been found in binary systems. However, astronomers have long suspected that these binary black holes are the exception and that, within the Milky Way, most exist on their own.

title: Rare bone disease often goes untreated while patients quietly live with chronic pain
desc: Teeth and bones are among the hardest structures in the human body, but certain inherited conditions can rob them of that strength. One of them is hypophosphatasia (HPP), a rare, lifelong genetic bone disorder that disrupts the development of bones and teeth, leaving them unusually soft and fragile. A recent study set out to determine how common HPP is across Central and Eastern Europe and how it presents in patients.

title: Breakfast briefing: Despite challenges, global economy still expanding solidly
desc: US factory PMIs expanding; China PMIs weak; other Asian PMIs robust; copper price rising; Australian inflation stays high; eyes on SpaceX and KPMG; UST 10yr at 4.69%; gold dips; oil falls hard; NZ$1 = 58.6 USc; TWI-5 = 62.4

title: Researchers recreate imagined melodies from brain activity
desc: In a study led by Jii Kwon and Chun Kee Chung, from Seoul National University, researchers explored whether they could recreate melodies from the brain activity of people imagining how songs continue after listening to a few bars.

title: Still No Accountability for Zimbabwe’s 2018 Abuses
desc: Eight years on, justice is still elusive for the families of 6 people killed and the 35 injured by Zimbabwe state security forces during the August 1, 2018, protests.
